semantic_meaning: Displays an evidence/source card tied to a non-obvious claim (source_map-backed).
when_to_use: When introducing a hard stat card or estimate qualifier
When transitioning from claim to evidence moment
when_not_to_use: If you cannot provide at least a source_map reference ID

animation_behavior.description: Card slides in, locks, highlights the exact cited fragment, then collapses into a small pinned source tag.

input_parameters.name: claim_id
input_parameters.description: Stable ID for the claim being supported.

input_parameters.name: source_map_ref
input_parameters.description: Reference key into the episode source_map.

state_beats.label: lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Card locks; claim-to-source link is clear.

state_beats.label: pin
state_beats.meaningful_change: Card collapses into pinned source tag.

expected_outputs: An evidence moment that visibly ties a claim to a source_map reference
validation_notes: If claim is an estimate, must include an on-screen qualifier.
